ASK_REQUIRED_FIELDS: Use the question tool to collect each required field
CROSS_REVIEW_CONFIG: The tool reads configuration from `.opencode/cross-review.json` (project) and then `~/.config/opencode/cross-review.json` (global); project keys override global. A `reviewers` array assigns each reviewer its own optional `focus`; `reviewModels` values are assigned round-robin across the reviewer count. An optional `reviewerTimeoutMs` (5000-3600000, default 600000) sets the per-session deadline for reviewers and the explicit judge; an explicit `--reviewer-timeout-ms` flag overrides it.
CROSS_REVIEW_ORCHESTRATION: Call `cross_review_start` once with the normalized arguments and retain its `runID`. Poll with `cross_review_status`; each call reconciles child sessions, enforces reviewer deadlines, and fills available concurrency slots. Call `cross_review_finalize` after reviewers become terminal. If it starts an explicit judge, poll status until the judge is terminal and finalize again. Use `cross_review_cancel` for cancellation. Do not call the legacy blocking `cross_review` tool.
MODEL_NAMING: Use exact OpenCode `provider/model` identifiers from `opencode models`; malformed, disconnected, or unavailable models are errors.
RESOLVE_AMBIGUITY: Resolve ambiguity with the question tool
